name: Namaiki Yume-chan wa Onii to Mechakucha H Shitai!
original_name: ナマイキユメちゃんはおにぃとメチャクチャＨしたい！
source:
When the protagonist goes to his parent's home for the first time in a while, a self-confident girl awaits him there.
Her name is Hinamori Yume.
They used to play together like real siblings because their parents were close friends.
Because of that relationship, Yume moves into the protagonist's home to prepare for her entrance exams.

Although she normally has a cheeky attitude, Yume has a secret.
The truth is, she loves the protagonist very much!
Now that they can live together as she had hoped, there's no way she will miss this chance!

Thus, Yume's fierce attack on the protagonist is about to begin――

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://willplus-japan.com/tokohana/product/namaiki/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公时隔许久回到老家，却见一名自信满满的少女正在那里等着他。
她的名字叫日菜森梦。
由于双方父母交情深厚，两人从小就像亲兄妹一样一起玩耍。
正因为这层关系，为了备战升学考试的梦住进了主人公家里。

虽然平时态度嚣张任性，但梦心中其实藏着一个秘密——
其实，她最喜欢主人公了！
如今终于如愿以偿能够同居，她绝不会放过这个大好机会！

就这样，梦对主人公的猛烈攻势即将开始——

[编译自[url=http://willplus-japan.com/tokohana/product/namaiki/#story]官方网站[/url]]
